ability.name: Empathic Link
ability.description: Paladin has empathic link with mount up to 1 mile; senses and emotional state shared.

ability.name: Improved Evasion
ability.description: On a successful Reflex save mount takes no damage; on a failed save only half.

ability.name: Share Spells
ability.description: Paladin can have any spell cast on himself also affect the mount if it is within 5 ft.

ability.name: Share Saving Throws
ability.description: Mount uses its own save bonuses or the paladin's, whichever are higher.

ability.name: Improved Speed
ability.description: Mount's land speed increases by 10 ft.

ability.name: Command Creatures of Its Kind
ability.description: Command other creatures of approximately the same kind (but not mount's own sort) as the spell command (DC 10 + 1/2 paladin level + Cha mod), once per day per two paladin levels, as a free action.

ability.name: Spell Resistance
ability.description: Spell resistance equal to paladin level + 5.
